campaign.name: And Then the Dragons Came: Purewater
campaign.description: A Classic Fantasy Imperative port of 'And then the Dragons Came', relocated to Purewater -- a Venice-like canal city where the sacred waters of the Lake Lady meet the sea. Baron Hanzo di Teufel arrives with his Dragon Knights for the Lake Lady's Tourney, his possessed champion concealed among them. Four strangers arrive the same week. Built as a living world: every NPC and faction runs its own agenda on a clock, and what the party does not witness happens anyway.

acts.title: FIRST CUSTOMERS AND THE MIDNIGHT EXCHANGE
acts.for: Establish Nimras's independent business through a modest paid recovery commission. Let completed work earn contacts and later offer a separately priced, knowingly risky magical auction job. Reveal estate connections through actual discoveries, not exposition. Opening is Rennic handing him Nessa's request at the fellowship house.
acts.takes: Initially time, agreed expenses and a prospective customer's trust. No mandatory injury, theft, ambush or accepted criminal work. Later chosen heists can put freedom, property and safety at risk.

acts.title: THE ASHWICK PAPERS
acts.for: If chosen, follow recovered evidence into the March, infiltrate surviving estate operations, recover stolen property and discover the demonological purpose and suppression of animists. Prepare live cast and operations against actual first-adventure outcomes before activating them.
acts.takes: Risks come from actual informed opponents and surviving resources. No compulsory capture or loss; official help and early victory can finish the scheme.

acts.title: THE UNBOUND DEAD
acts.for: If still relevant and chosen, reach the Drakesfall-edge chapel, interrupt a surviving binding venture or undertake restitution and spiritual release. Nimras's spellcasting and choices are consequential alongside an independent animist ally.
acts.takes: People, freedom and spiritual captivity are stakes, not prescribed losses. No reinstated Baron plot, replacement boss or compulsory ritual fight after effective prevention.

acts.title: FIRST CUSTOMERS AND THE MIDNIGHT EXCHANGE / A ROAD PEOPLE CAN USE
acts.for: Hrill: Give Hrill a practical accomplishment at a broken crossing, then a journey through isolated communities. His calm, persuasion and judgement can get people working together; his physical skills matter. Discover why Vaust's offer of protection attracts support. Reach the hospice, learn the two possible routes, and decide whether to take any continuing role. No job is accepted for him.
acts.takes: Hrill: At risk are a stranded traveller, medicine and a usable crossing; subsequently access and local trust. Losses require actual choices and resolution. No compulsory rescue failure, guilt, recruitment or combat.

acts.title: THE ASHWICK PAPERS / THE PRICE OF ORDER
acts.for: Hrill: Explore Wind Stair and Alder Hame, discover the difference between Vaust's public road scheme and his coercive programme, and contest its actual dependencies. Military knowledge can identify what the camp is preparing. Hrill can negotiate, organise, investigate, bypass the camp or seek genuine Crown assistance. He decides what loyalty and ending the killing require. Shared global context: imperial restorationists need willing communities, routes and stolen spiritual heritage; Nimras's separate venture is not a prerequisite and nobody knows his discoveries.
acts.takes: Hrill: At risk are freedom of movement, homes, local consent and specific people during a possible armed eviction. Threats need warnings, means and earned information. Peaceful settlements and early antagonist defeat can end this act.

acts.title: THE UNBOUND DEAD / WHAT THE ROAD IS FOR
acts.for: Hrill: Turn surviving discoveries and alliances into a decisive opportunity: establish a community-controlled route, prevent a surviving eviction or intercept the actual relic wagon. The restored route and independent communities are lasting gains. Relic restitution is possible without undertaking a global war. A defeated Vaust stays defeated; no mandatory working, monster, replacement boss or last fight.
acts.takes: Hrill: At risk are the particular route, people and assets still contested. Clear victory, negotiated protection, partial recovery and withdrawal stand. The Dragon Kings' return is an opposed project, never an inevitable consequence.

opening_text: Beyond Wendlow, water rattles over stones beneath Ashen Span. A cart hangs crooked through the bridge’s broken decking; its driver straddles a beam, his boot pinned under the shaft. Beside you, a woman braces a rope around a stone post. A jack and loose timbers lie at her feet. “Can you hold this?”
